purpose: Selected checkpoints, in spine order. Runtime capability gates read the existing BiomeGrammar, not this presentation list.

stages.title: A point on a ground
stages.text: A position. No future panels, foliage or trees are visible.

stages.title: The face arrives
stages.text: The quads stand at ground level. Their two triangles make a surface; collision gives it a boundary for a body.

stages.title: The face rises
stages.text: Translation lifts the same panels 2.35 metres. They remain grey and unpatterned, and stay raised.

stages.title: A different orientation
stages.text: The raised faces turn 45 degrees. The form is retained while its relation to the space changes.

stages.title: A narrower face
stages.text: Width changes from 1.1 to 0.66 metres. The taller proportion suggests a banner.

stages.title: Colour arrives
stages.text: Each face receives its own plain palette. Pattern has not arrived yet.

stages.title: A rule on the surface
stages.text: The patterns chapter gives the faces repeated geometric markings. The earlier translation and colour remain.

stages.title: The world gains inhabitants
stages.text: The current biome rules now provide fungi and wandering bodies. The banners remain recognisable among them.

stages.title: Branching joins the scene
stages.text: Trees arrive through the existing growth vocabulary. The earlier sculpture stays within this more populated world.
